title: Gina security.json
description: Per-bundle internal security settings (tokens, session secrets, signing keys). The file belongs to the application: the framework reads only the keys documented here and carries everything else through untouched, so an application is free to keep its own conventions alongside them. Merged shared-config-first, then the bundle's own copy, then the `security.<env>.json` overlay — each layer overriding the one before it.

session.description: Session settings. The framework interprets `expires` and `remember`; every other key here is the application's own.

expires.description: Cookie lifetime applied at `req.login()` for an ordinary login. Omit it to leave the cookie exactly as the session factory made it (a browser-session cookie, unless the application set a maxAge of its own).

remember.description: Cookie lifetime applied at `req.login()` when the login is remembered — the caller passed `{ remember: true }`, or the login request carried a truthy `remember` field. Falls back to `expires` when omitted.

duration.description: A unit-suffixed duration string. The unit is REQUIRED — a bare number is refused rather than guessed. Accepted units: ms, s, m, h, d (case-insensitive). A value that cannot be parsed, or that is not positive, is reported at boot and then ignored: the bundle keeps the cookie lifetime it already had, and the boot is never refused.
